_doc: Headwords for the English generators (spec P2b §4). w word; lvl class 0..7 (0 = KG); pos every part of speech a child may meet (n v adj adv pron prep conj interj); cat noun group; plural, past, pp, s3, ing, comp, sup inflections (checked against the British word list); irr irregular verb; edRule ed|d|ied|double; compRule er|r|ier|double|more|irr|both; count false for uncountable nouns; an true when it takes 'an'; opp single-sense opposite; syn safe synonyms; rhyme word-family key; syl syllables and sylBreak the claps; pic picture id in pictures.json; miss misspellings and gaps (position -> letters that make no word) for picture words; contested true to keep out of category questions. Built by boretube-learn/tools/content/data/english_data.py; do not edit by hand.
